{"description":"A Question gains an addressee and an answerer. answer_question takes the answerer and the record the answer became, and draws ANSWERS in the same call. A read returns one person's open questions as a batch, each with the evidence it rests on. Planned by the 2026-09-29 fix program.

BUILT AND MERGED: PR #634, squash commit b519bb1 on main (2026-09-29). Recorded on main as chg:a-question-is-put-to-a-person-and-records-who-answered and ver:a-question-is-put-to-a-person-and-records-who-answered, anchored on cap:questions because this node was not yet on main. Once this design and main's export meet, draw VERIFIES from that ver to this capability, and INVALIDATES from that chg to the two root-cause facts.

THE SHAPE BUILT. Question.asked_of and Question.answered_by are node references to a Contributor, refused otherwise. Question.answered_via records the acting agent from the ACTS_FOR rung (#632) beside the answerer and draws ACTS_FOR to them. The Question also carries answered_at, batch and batch_position. answer_question takes answered_by, answered_at, record and note, and draws ANSWERS from record in the same call. A name that resolves to nothing is refused with nothing written, and a later answer that names nobody clears the last answerer. gaps_to_prompts and gap_to_prompt take asked_of, batch, and per-question evidence, which is drawn as ASKS_ABOUT and must resolve. Questions are numbered in the order they were put, and a number is kept on a re-ask. open_questions(asked_of) returns one person's batch in order, each question with evidence links (id, type, name) to every node it asks about, plus answered_in. It says how many open questions it left out. Unscoped, every row carries asked_of (null when nobody was named). loop_status(contributor_id) lists questions_put_to_them and counts them against that person's clean.

THE OPTION CHOSEN, from dec:idea-a-question-is-addressed-to-a-person-and-travels-as-a-batch-with-its-evidence, which stays OPEN (this records what was built; it does not settle it): (b) + (c) + the links-only form of (d).
- (b) Addressee and answerer are PROPERTIES, not AUTHORED_BY roles. An author role would say the answerer made the question. An approver role on an asked Question already means "assigned, not yet given", which makes a different addressee and answerer ambiguous.
- (c) A batch is a name plus a number on each Question, with no new record type.
- (d) Evidence is links through the existing ASKS_ABOUT. describe_schema(Question, TemporalFact) ranks it the only edge FOR a Question source. CALIBRATED_AGAINST reaches only Artifact and Verification and is a traceability edge. HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT is a stored twin of a finding's own subject.

WHY THE OTHERS LOST.
- (a) Nothing: the measured cost is a hand-carried relay plus a scratch-file map.
- (c) As a node type: it adds a type and an edge to say what two properties already say.
- (d) As a bundle the asker writes: the counter-argument holds. Curated evidence is what the owner won by reading past, so the batch hands over links to the whole ASKS_ABOUT set (the gap's own nodes as well as the asker's picks), never a digest.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS KEPT.
- The loop stays gentle: a question put to a person counts only in that person's scoped loop_status.
- Question.question stays immutable.
- Nothing is guessed.","name":"A Question names whom it was put to and who answered; answer_question draws ANSWERS in the same call; a person's open questions read as one batch with evidence links","provenance":"authored","status":"planned"}
